title: Marked polygon correlations and one-arc bounds
summary: At the critical honeycomb vertex activity, the squared-length mass of simple polygons of diameter at most H , counted modulo translations, is at most $`H^{2/3+o(1)}`$. We also prove a quantitative two-mark cylinder estimate and a polynomial one-arc bound uniform even for arbitrarily unequal marked intervals.
family_title: The three-quarter exponent for honeycomb self-avoiding walk

review.reason: Gives bounds on polygon mass and marked-arc estimates at critical honeycomb vertex activity.
